resources.string: Works only when you ask DSH to do something on your phone: it reads the text on the current screen (and takes a screenshot when needed), then taps, types and swipes as you ask. Screen content is sent to the DeepSeek model you chose in DSH. While it works, a bar at the top of the screen lets you pause, stop or steer at any time; actions like sending, paying or deleting ask you first. DSH never fills in passwords or verification codes, never pays for you, and never changes system settings or permissions.
DSH is using your phone. Tap to expand
